ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of heat in? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of heat in.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of heat in.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of heat in.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of heat in.

2. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 0 °C

3. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

4. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Only water vapour

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Harmonious? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Harmonious.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Harmonious.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Harmonious.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Harmonious.

6. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and its resources.

8. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Producers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Decomposers only

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety when? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety when.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Safety when.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety when.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety when.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dangers of heat? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dangers of heat.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dangers of heat.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dangers of heat.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Dangers of heat.

11. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

12. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. joule (J)
   C. watt (W)
   D. newton (N)

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Keeping safe from? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Keeping safe from.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping safe from.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Keeping safe from.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Keeping safe from.

14. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants and its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Plants and its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plants and its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plants and its resources.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy: Heat and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Energy: Heat and its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy: Heat and its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy: Heat and its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy: Heat and its resources.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for water environment collecting rain water and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for water and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Caring For Energy environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Weather and its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Keeping safe from and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Water its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
